title: IMPROVE feature model broad-scale validation of T-cell recognition
evidence_note: 17,520 patient-matched screened records; already frozen as principal benchmark; exact PRIME2 overlap audited separately.

title: Profiling immunogenic neoantigen peptides elicited by personalized neoantigen vaccine
evidence_note: 2,317 administered 8-11mer peptides from 352 patients; individual IFN-gamma ELISPOT; 313 source positives under ratio >=2.0; already frozen and run.

title: NCI Surgery Branch mutated minimal peptide test set
evidence_note: 2.36-GB file enumerates short candidates derived from parent screens; row-level short-peptide experimental testing is not established, so unknown rows cannot be negatives.

title: A neoantigen vaccine generates antitumour immunity in renal cell carcinoma
evidence_note: Checksum-pinned Supplementary Table 2 sheet 2 has 130 source rows from 9 patients; 129 retained rows have canonical short epitope, predicted HLA and three peptide-stimulation plus three no-stimulation replicates. One N/A short-epitope/HLA row is excluded. Positives are defined by source p-value threshold; endpoint is post-vaccine ELISpot and therefore endpoint-distinct from untreated natural presentation.

title: Dose escalation study of a personalized peptide-based neoantigen vaccine
evidence_note: The paper reports 91 individually restimulated long vaccine peptides and patient IDs, but the public evidence does not expose a complete row-level short-peptide-HLA table with experimental negatives; HLA/minimal epitopes are prediction-derived and responses use irrelevant-peptide background rather than a verified pMHC negative table.

title: Integrating Multisector Molecular Characterization into Personalized Peptide Vaccine Design for GBM
evidence_note: Figshare item is TCR-sequence data; article says IFN-gamma ELISPOT for patients 1-3, but the located artifact does not establish a complete row-level pMHC table with HLA and experimental negatives.

title: Personal neoantigen vaccines induce persistent memory T-cell responses
evidence_note: Supplementary data emphasize vaccine-positive responses, pools and class-II work; paper states patient-related data may require MTA and does not establish a complete individually tested class-I negative table.

title: NEPdb experimentally validated neoantigens and predicted neoepitopes
evidence_note: Curated records include effective/ineffective entries and HLA, but patient identity, assay denominator and source-cohort reconstruction are not guaranteed at record level; database/model-training overlap risk is high.

title: TESLA consortium validation set
evidence_note: Experimentally tested patient-matched records are real, but all 520 retained pilot rows exactly overlap PRIME2 training and BigMHC immunogenicity construction; retained only as leakage-positive control.

title: Unraveling tumor-specific neoantigen immunogenicity prediction
evidence_note: Includes curated presented neoantigens and simulated prioritization scenarios, but the full patient-linked experimental-negative contract needed here is not established from the public article/database description.
